enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the quilt over the body. Close eyes. Turn onto the left side. Pull the pillow under the head. Shift the legs. Turn onto the right side. enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth

Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the rack. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Turn on the tap. Rinse the brush under the water. Brush teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back into the cup. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

Turn off the tap.
